verdict.rationale: Zero's own MCP server exposes a broad set of mailbox operations: reading threads, listing folders, sending emails and drafts, deleting, bulk archiving, managing labels, marking read/unread, search and AI compose. That is a real programmatic surface covering many core UI actions. However, there is no documented public HTTP API or endpoint schema, authentication requires copying a browser session cookie (OAuth is 'coming soon'), and nothing shows parity with the UI. Missing for 10: a documented public API with schema, evidence of UI parity (settings, provider connection, UI customization, categorization), stable non-cookie authentication, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Get email threads by ID - List emails in specific folders - Create and send new emails - Create email drafts - Send existing drafts - Delete emails

Mark emails as read/unread
- Modify email labels
Bulk delete emails - Bulk archive emails
